name: osint-toolkit
title: OSINT Toolkit
description: Comprehensive OSINT toolkit for security analysts to research IOCs (IPs, domains, URLs, hashes) across multiple threat intelligence platforms
author: jergensturdley

commands.name: search-ioc
commands.title: Search IOC
commands.subtitle: OSINT Toolkit
commands.description: Auto-detect and search any IOC (IP, domain, URL, hash) across OSINT platforms

arguments.name: ioc
arguments.placeholder: Enter IP, domain, URL, or hash

commands.name: search-ip
commands.title: Search IP Address
commands.subtitle: OSINT Toolkit
commands.description: Search IP addresses across threat intelligence platforms

commands.name: search-domain
commands.title: Search Domain
commands.subtitle: OSINT Toolkit
commands.description: Search domains across threat intelligence platforms

commands.name: search-url
commands.title: Search URL
commands.subtitle: OSINT Toolkit
commands.description: Search URLs across threat intelligence platforms

commands.name: search-hash
commands.title: Search File Hash
commands.subtitle: OSINT Toolkit
commands.description: Search file hashes (MD5, SHA1, SHA256) across threat intelligence platforms

commands.name: import-source
commands.title: Import Custom Source
commands.subtitle: OSINT Toolkit
commands.description: Import a custom OSINT source by pasting JSON

preferences.name: summary_only_mode
preferences.title: Show Only Summary Rows
preferences.description: When enabled, hide individual source entries and show only per-IOC summary items.
preferences.label: Enabled

preferences.name: virustotal_api_key
preferences.title: VirusTotal API Key
preferences.description: API key for VirusTotal (optional, free lookups work without it)

preferences.name: enable_alienvault
preferences.title: Enable AlienVault OTX
preferences.description: Show AlienVault OTX in search results
preferences.label: Enabled

preferences.name: enable_hybridanalysis
preferences.title: Enable Hybrid Analysis
preferences.description: Show Hybrid Analysis in search results
preferences.label: Enabled

preferences.name: copy_on_select
preferences.title: Copy IOC on Selection
preferences.description: Automatically copy the IOC to clipboard when selecting a search result
preferences.label: Enabled

preferences.name: enable_haveibeenpwned
preferences.title: Enable Have I Been Pwned
preferences.description: Enable Have I Been Pwned in search results (for email IOCs)
preferences.label: Enabled

preferences.name: show_hibp_quick_link
preferences.title: Show Have I Been Pwned Quick Link
preferences.description: Show a quick action for Have I Been Pwned when an email IOC is detected.
preferences.label: Enabled

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run lint
